name: Drop bad epochs
summary: Drops bad epochs by index from MNE-Python epoched MEG/EEG data with Epochs.drop, taking indices from a parameter and/or a file, with before/after plots and an HTML report.
description: Reads epochs, collects the indices to remove from the drop parameter and from an optional file containing comma-separated indices (passed through the events field), removes them with mne.Epochs.drop and saves the remaining epochs together with a summary and figures. Use it to remove epochs flagged as bad by visual inspection or another QC step. Indices refer to the current epochs in the file (0-based).

inputs.description: Epoched file to remove epochs from.

SPECIAL HACK:
events.tsv contains a list of bad trials as a single line with comma-separated indices to drop

parameters.description: Set epochs to remove by specifying indices to remove. Events are correspondingly modified.

citations.text: Hayashi S., Caron B. A., Heinsfeld A. S. et al. brainlife.io: a decentralized and open-source cloud platform to support neuroscience research. Nature Methods 21, 809-813 (2024).
Gramfort A. et al. MEG and EEG data analysis with MNE-Python. Frontiers in Neuroscience 7:267 (2013).
